Method of Attack: Phishing campaign targeting AWS logins using Google Ads to display malicious search results; Redirecting victims from Google Ads to a fake AWS login page hosted on attacker-controlled domains; Using JavaScript to disable right clicks and keyboard shortcuts to prevent navigation away from phishing pages; Categorizing stolen credentials by prompting users to select root or IAM user before entering credentials
Attack Vector: Malicious Google Ads leading to phishing domains; Phishing websites mimicking legitimate blogs and AWS login pages
